Alnam no Kiba - Juuzoku Juuni Shinto Den.name: Alnam no Kiba: Juuzoku Juuni Shinto Densetsu
Alnam no Kiba - Juuzoku Juuni Shinto Den.summary:
Alnam no Kiba: Juuzoku Juuni Shinto Densetsu
is a 1994 Japanese role-playing game (RPG) about a young beastman named Kenbu, whose village is attacked by monsters. To protect his people and avenge his mentor, Kenbu leaves home to fight alongside other heroes and discover the origin of the creatures threatening the world.

Himitsu no Hanazono.name: Himitsu no Hanazono
Himitsu no Hanazono.summary: Himitsu no Hanazono is essentially a visual novel. There are no verb commands and no real interaction with the environment. The choices are rather frequent and fairly numerous (usually four or five choices at most screens). Most of these choices, however, do not affect the plot, though they may alter subsequent dialogue. The player is also able to navigate the protagonist on school grounds and inside the main building in a top-down fashion, visiting locations in any order.

Master of Monsters.name: Master of Monsters
Master of Monsters.summary:
Port of "Master of Monsters" for the TurboGrafx-16/PC Engine.

Master of Monsters is a turn-based strategy game in which you choose one of five different wizards and fight the other wizards for domination of the land that stands without a ruler after the master wizard's death. You can play in two campaigns against the computer which requires you to defeat the enemy wizards on all maps and allows you to take all units that have survived a battle into the next one. You can also play all maps individually with up two four human players. In battles, you can summon different monsters and cast spells. Which monsters you can summon and which spells you can use depends on which wizard you have chosen.

Valis IV.name: Valis IV
Valis IV.summary:
Yuko has become the goddess of the world of Vecanti and has watched over the world in peace since the defeat of Glames. Trouble brews when the Dark World prince named Galgear begins to search for a magical ring. This ring increases his powers, but to the loss of control he could have maintained under its effects, and the gods of Vecanti recognize this and imprison Galgear inside a crystal sunk into the ocean.

Fifteen years pass, and Galgear manages to break out of his prison, kidnapping the former heroine Valna and being pursued by troops led by Cham as a result. A member of her band, named Lena Brande, requests permission to infiltrate Galgear's stronghold and free Valna.
